blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Taxes fall into two groups. Direct taxes are paid directly by the person or company who owes them. Income tax and corporate tax are the classic examples. You know exactly what you owe, and you pay it yourself.

Indirect taxes are collected through someone else. Sales tax is the clearest case. The shop adds the tax to the price, collects it from the customer, and then hands it to the government. The customer pays, but the shop does the work.

Direct taxes feel more visible. Indirect taxes feel almost invisible — until you realise they sit quietly in almost every price you see.

items.q: Who pays a direct tax?
options: The person or company who owes it
items.why: "Direct taxes are paid directly by the person or company who owes them."

items.q: How is an indirect tax collected?
options: Through someone else, like a shop
items.why: "Indirect taxes are collected through someone else."

items.q: What is a classic example of a direct tax?
items.why: "income tax and corporate tax are the classic examples."

items.q: The text suggests that indirect taxes are…
options: easy to see on every receipt
hidden in the price of many things
items.why: Inferência: "they sit quietly in almost every price" — estão escondidos no preço.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: people often do not notice indirect taxes
shops keep the sales tax for themselves
items.why: Inferência: se são "almost invisible" e "quietly" no preço, as pessoas não os percebem.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Harry mostrando um recibo ao novo colega. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Come here, look at this. This is a receipt from the coffee shop next door. It's small, but it tells you a lot.

See this line here? That's the price of my coffee. Three pounds. And look, just below it — sales tax. The shop added it to the price. I paid the shop, and later the shop hands that tax to the government. That's an indirect tax. I paid it, but the shop does the work. Most people never even notice it.

Now, income tax is different. That comes out of my salary every month. Nobody collects it for me. I owe it, and I pay it myself. That's a direct tax. It's very visible — I see it on my payslip every time.

So, same person, two taxes. One I can see clearly, one is hiding in the price of a coffee. That's the whole idea: direct and indirect. Easy, right?
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is Harry showing the junior?
options: A receipt from a coffee shop
items.why: "This is a receipt from the coffee shop next door."

items.q: Why is the sales tax an indirect tax?
options: Harry pays it, but the shop hands it to the government
The government adds it to the coffee
items.why: "I paid it, but the shop does the work" e a loja entrega o imposto ao governo.

items.q: How does Harry pay his income tax?
options: It comes out of his salary and he pays it himself
He pays it at the coffee shop
items.why: "That comes out of my salary… I owe it, and I pay it myself."

items.q: Harry says most people never notice the sales tax. This suggests that…
options: the sales tax is very large
indirect taxes are easy to miss
items.why: Inferência: se ninguém repara, o imposto indireto passa despercebido.

items.q: What is Harry's main point?
options: One tax is easy to see, the other hides in the price
items.why: Inferência: "One I can see clearly, one is hiding in the price of a coffee."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I owe the government some tax this year." To owe means to…
items.why: To owe = dever, ter de pagar algo.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The shop ___ the tax from every customer and sends it to the government."
items.why: To collect = coletar; a loja coleta o imposto dos clientes.

items.q: "Income tax is very visible on your payslip." Visible means…
items.why: Visible = visível, fácil de ver.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The tax sits ___ inside the price, so nobody notices it."
items.why: Quietly = silenciosamente; o imposto fica escondido sem chamar atenção.

items.q: "The shop hands the tax to the government." To hand to means to…
items.why: To hand to = entregar a alguém.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem em conversas sobre impostos e preços. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The tax is added to the price at the till." Added to means…
items.why: Add to = somar, juntar ao preço.

items.q: "Income tax comes out of your salary each month." This means it is…
items.why: Come out of = sair de, ser descontado do salário.

items.q: "Please hand over the tax to the government." To hand over means to…
items.why: Hand over = entregar algo a alguém.

items.q: "Sales taxes add up over a year." To add up means to…
items.why: Add up = somar, virar um total grande.

items.q: "The accountant pointed out the tax on the receipt." To point out means to…
items.why: Point out = apontar, mostrar algo para alguém.
